title: Backup operations: CLI restore, web backup UI with downloads
summary: cli/backup.php and cli/restore.php remain the core operations. Admin web UI under System > Backup/Restore now supports running backup and downloading backup ZIPs; restore was intentionally removed from web and kept CLI-only. CLI restore upload behavior mirrors backup uploads over existing files (overwrite same paths, retain unmatched existing files).

items: ZIP: manifest.json, database.sql, uploads/** from public/uploads
Fallback PDO exporter for base tables and views

Added --large-mode for GB-scale runs: stream mysqldump output directly to database.sql (no in-memory SQL), preflight free-space estimate, lower zip compression overhead, and progress output while archiving uploads
mysql client stdin import from database.sql or PDO statement splitter
Added --large-mode for GB-scale restore runs: extraction preflight checks, unlimited runtime/memory safeguards, and progress output for SQL execution (PDO path) and uploads mirror copy
Added pre-restore impact preview before confirmation: SQL changes summary, destination DB summary, and uploads replace/add/retain estimates with sample paths
After confirmation, restore now auto-creates a safety backup under storage/backups/paper-before-restore-*.zip; restore aborts if this backup step fails
Ignore all backup files; track .gitignore only
Wrap CORS and OPTIONS short-circuit in PHP_SAPI !== 'cli' so CLI bootstrap does not touch REQUEST_METHOD
Added admin page/controller to trigger backup via web and list backup ZIP files
Added secure per-file download action for backup archives
Removed web restore route/flow to keep restore CLI-only for controlled operations
Added CLI php.exe resolver/validator for Windows/XAMPP web execution safety (supports PHP_CLI_PATH)
